t: DEWALT DCF787D2T-SFGB 18V XR cordless impact driver is a powerful tool designed for efficient fastening tasks. The brushless motor technology provides extended run-time and improved efficiency compared to brushed alternatives, making it ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general construction work. The compact 137mm length and lightweight 1.2kg design allow access into confined spaces, while the ergonomic soft-grip handle ensures comfortable use and precise control. The impact driver delivers 170Nm of torque and includes variable speed and all-metal gearing, to deliver robust performance and durability. Also equipped with an integrated LED work light to illuminate the work area, and an electronic brake to enhance user safety. Supplied with 2 x 2.0Ah Li-Ion batteries, charger and TSTAK case.
